narrative: Visionary technology executive with 20 years of experience scaling global engineering organizations, driving enterprise-wide digital transformations, and architecting resilient cloud infrastructure. Proven expertise in growing engineering teams from 50 to 400+ across international offices, managing $50M+ P&L budgets, and leading M&A technical integrations. Passionate about aligning technology strategy with business objectives to accelerate ARR growth and foster a culture of engineering excellence.

education.details: Completed while serving as Director of Engineering. Focus on organizational design, corporate finance, and strategic M&A integration.
Graduated Magna Cum Laude. Specialization in Systems Architecture and Distributed Computing.

experience.bullets: Scaled the global engineering organization from 85 to 320+ personnel across 4 international development centers, reducing delivery cycle times by 40%, Managed an annual departmental budget of $55M, successfully reducing cloud infrastructure spend by 22% ($4.1M) through aggressive AWS optimization and architectural refactoring, Spearheaded the technical due diligence and system integration for three major corporate acquisitions, seamlessly onboarding 1.2M new users with zero unscheduled downtime, Championed a shift to a microservices architecture, decommissioning a 10-year-old monolith and increasing system reliability to 99.99%

Directed a team of 45 DevOps and SRE professionals to build and maintain a multi-region hybrid cloud platform serving Fortune 500 clients, Drove the adoption of Kubernetes and containerization across the enterprise, reducing environment provisioning time from 3 weeks to 45 minutes, Partnered directly with the C-suite to define the 3-year technology roadmap, directly contributing to a successful $120M Series D funding round

Architected the core high-frequency trading data ingestion pipeline in C++ and Java, capable of processing 2M+ transactions per second with sub-millisecond latency, Mentored a cohort of 15 senior engineers and established the company's first internal Architecture Review Board (ARB) to standardize design patterns across all product lines
Developed full-stack web applications using Java Spring and early JavaScript frameworks, Lead developer for the proprietary billing module that processed $10M in ARR

target.jobDescription: Vanguard Tech Innovations is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to lead our global technology strategy. The ideal candidate will have 15+ years of software engineering experience with at least 7 years in a VP or C-level leadership role. You will oversee an engineering organization of 500+, direct our enterprise cloud strategy, and partner with the CEO to evaluate technical targets for future acquisitions. We need a leader who is highly commercial, deeply technical, and capable of driving operational excellence across diverse, distributed teams. Experience managing budgets exceeding $30M and successfully executing legacy modernization initiatives is required.
